title: Enterprise POS Configuration Template
description: Every configuration variable with placeholder values and descriptions for production setup.

port.description: Port number on which the API and static SPA server listens

corsOrigin.description: Allowed origin for CORS requests in development mode

jwtSecret.description: Cryptographic signing secret used for JSON Web Token generation

jwtExpiresIn.description: Token lifespan before requiring user re-authentication

rateLimitWindowMs.description: Sliding rate limit window in milliseconds (15 minutes = 900000ms)

rateLimitMaxRequests.description: Maximum authentication attempts per IP address within the rate limit window

dialect.description: Active database adapter dialect (sqlite, postgres, mysql)

connectionString.description: File path for SQLite or connection URI for PostgreSQL/MySQL

autoMigrate.description: Automatically run schema migrations on startup if tables are missing

autoSeed.description: Automatically seed default admin, catalog, and store data on first run

shopName.description: Store branding name displayed on terminal header and receipts

shopAddress.description: Physical retail store address printed on receipts

shopPhone.description: Customer service contact number printed on invoices

currencyCode.description: Standard ISO 4217 Currency Code (e.g. BDT, USD, EUR)

currencySymbol.description: Currency display symbol used across the interface

defaultTaxRate.description: Standard default Value Added Tax (VAT) rate in percentage

thermalPrinterWidth.description: Receipt printer paper roll width (58mm or 80mm)

receiptFooter.value: Thank you for shopping with us! No returns without receipt.
receiptFooter.description: Customized message printed at the bottom of thermal receipts
